svg.title: Azure 101 Lab topology preview
svg.desc: Per-group topology for the Azure 101 Lab. Shows subscription-scope policy, budget, and Activity Log diagnostics; a shared resource group holding the Log Analytics workspace, data collection rule, and user-assigned managed identity; a NetworkWatcherRG with VNet flow logs; and a lab resource group with two peered VNets, Azure Bastion, two Ubuntu VMs, two NSGs, a storage account, and a disk-usage alert. Five real faults from Modules 1-7 are annotated in red.
svg.text: Two peered VNets · Two Ubuntu VMs · Shared Log Analytics · Five baked-in faults across Modules 1–7
